Command.Statement: with member [Measures].[Rendite] as '(([Measures].[Store Sales] - [Measures].[Store Cost]) / [Measures].[Store Cost])', format_string = IIf((((([Measures].[Store Sales] - [Measures].[Store Cost]) / [Measures].[Store Cost]) * 100) > Parameter("UpperLimit", NUMERIC, 151, "Obere Grenze")), "|#.00%|arrow='up'", IIf((((([Measures].[Store Sales] - [Measures].[Store Cost]) / [Measures].[Store Cost]) * 100) < Parameter("LowerLimit", NUMERIC, 150, "Untere Grenze")), "|#.00%|arrow='down'", "|#.00%|arrow='right'")) select {[Measures].Members} ON COLUMNS from [ZFMSALES]
